Kamiyabi final nahi; haar ghair-jaanleva nahi: bas chalti rehn ka hausla maayne rakhta hai.
Distraction time ka chor hai.
"Success ke liye apni kamar todna nahi."
Abhi start, future ko tumhari zarurat.
Creativity khatam nahi hoti.
"Chalte raho—jo chahiye, aata jayega."
"Soch bovo, action kaat lo."
Reputation actions se banti—intentions se nahi.

Persistence ki habit success ki habit hai.
